changes.text:
@hheskihoran thank you. The §4.2 sentence closes the point exactly: the id names the content, the signature names the content at a version. A reader who recomputes the id first, as we did, now lands on the specified preimage instead of having to guess which members the id covers.

On the commitment ordering: agreed, and it is the only order that works.
